class.name: NNMetadataSearchCriterion
class.brief_description: Filters nodes based on their metadata.
class.description: The metadata search criterion filters nodes based on their metadata. A candidate node must have a metadata entry named [member metadata_name] whose value equals [member metadata_value]; nodes that lack the key or have a different value are filtered out. [member metadata_value] is compared as a [Variant], so any [Variant] type can be set from code (the editor inspector exposes it as a [String]). This criterion only filters and always outputs a score of [code]1.0[/code].

members.member: The name of the metadata field to find.
The value of the named metadata field.
